mapper.update:
update cs_appointment
counselor_id = #{counselorId},
status = #{status},
where appointment_id = #{appointmentId}
mapper.select:
select ca.student_id as studentId, su.student_no as studentNo, su.real_name as realName, ca.appointment_id as appointmentId
from cs_appointment as ca left join sys_user as su on ca.student_id = su.user_id where ca.counselor_id = #{userId} and ca.status = 1
